name: @stageflow/contracts-report
description: Unified Report schema and types for Stageflow

scripts.generate: bun run generate:ts && bun run generate:go
scripts.generate:go: go run github.com/atombender/go-jsonschema@v0.20.0 --package report --tags json --struct-name-from-title schema/unified-report.v2.schema.json > generated/go/report_schema.go
scripts.validate:fixtures: node schema/validate.js fixtures/unified-report.v2.json && node schema/validate.js fixtures/unified-report.v2.all-scans.json
scripts.build: bun run generate && bun run validate:fixtures && tsc
